theorem.name: QuadraticTTDataDoNotSelectNonlinearActionTheorem
theorem.background: g(epsilon)=eta+epsilon h on a four-dimensional flat patch

deformation_family.action: S_alpha=S_EH+(alpha/kappa_h) integral sqrt(-g) C_mn^rs C_rs^ab C_ab^mn
properties: higher-than-second-order metric equation for alpha nonzero

order_proof.generic_nonvanishing: D3 Delta S_alpha[eta] is proportional to alpha times the cubic linearized-Weyl invariant and is nonzero for generic perturbations.

theorem.consequence: The selected metric map, global TT bundle, kappa_h, Fierz-Pauli Hessian, linearized diffeomorphism identity, and even full diffeomorphism invariance do not determine the nonlinear action. An infrared derivative-order/source theorem or equivalent suppression theorem is logically indispensable.

currently_closed: A51 finite one-form execution and selected rank-four single-Higgs projection

currently_open_or_conditional: MTT selection of the four-dimensional base Dirac geometry
MTT selection of the cutoff function or proper-time measure and moments
source-derived gauge overlap metric at strict no-knob tier
an infrared theorem controlling the Weyl-curvature and higher heat-kernel terms
matching the spectral TT Hessian and q79 zero/gap channels to the computed kappa_h block
spectral_action_exit.important_difference: The standard spectral action contains Einstein-Hilbert plus Weyl gravity, not pure two-derivative GR. It is therefore a superset route. Recovering GR requires a selected low-energy truncation with an error or decoupling certificate; it cannot bypass the derivative-order gate.
